Visitor skips code blocks from output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorSkipCodeBlocks struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorSkipCodeBlocks) VisitCodeBlock(ctx htmd.NodeContext, lang *string, code string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorSkipCodeBlocks{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Intro text</p><pre><code>let x = 42;</code></pre><p>Outro text</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
